name: Missing -ed
rule: When the story is in the past, the verb shows it.
Most verbs add -ed: walk → walked, cook → cooked.

wrong.text: Last week, the class clean the whole beach.

right.text: Last week, the class cleaned the whole beach.

spot: Look for a time word (yesterday, last year) or other past verbs in the same sentence.
deeper: Two verbs joined by 'and' stay in the same time: she washed and dried.
After 'have', 'has' or 'had' the -ed is also needed: they have walked.
Some verbs change instead: go → went, buy → bought.
